---
title: "Portafolio de Proyectos"
listing:
  - id: censo-projects
    contents: posts             # Busca en la carpeta posts
    include:
      categories: "Censo"       # Filtra solo lo que sea Censo
    type: grid                  # Estilo tarjeta
    sort: "date desc"
    fields: [image, date, title, subtitle, description]
    
  - id: finance-projects
    contents: posts
    include:
      categories: "Finanzas"    # Filtra solo lo que sea Finanzas
    type: list                  # Estilo lista (más serio para finanzas)
    sort: "date desc"
    fields: [date, title, description]
---
